details: A bridge build was started before Falsidade dependency completed. Both scripts initially numbered run 002 by counting completed JSON files. The bridge failed for missing Falsidade.olean. Its JSON/log were copied to premature_bridge_attempt_002 before the successful Falsidade build overwrote attempt_002 JSON/log. However both attempt_002.lean and premature_bridge_attempt_002.lean are Falsidade source, not the bridge source named by premature_bridge JSON. Do not infer snapshot provenance for the premature bridge build. That failed result contributes no proof. Numbering now counts reserved source snapshots; subsequent builds are sequential. Build source pin is captured before execution and checked afterward.
